question: In the review of magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles in mixed matrix membranes for wastewater, what tensile strength increase and river-water bacteria removal did the bacterial cellulose acetate membrane with Fe3O4 from pineapple biowaste reach?
expect: tensile strength up to 73%; bacteria removal 67.4% (Suryanto et al.)
rendered: According to the document, Suryanto et al. have been studied dye (congo red and acid orange) and bacterial removal by utilizing pineapple biowaste extraction to fabricate a bacterial cellulose acetate-based membrane incorporated magnetic nanoparticles (Fe3O4) of (0.25, 0.5, 0.75, and 1 wt%). The study revealed that there is been an increasing in tensile strength to 73%, and the work has been successful in removing bacteria from river wastewater to 67.4%.
